messages:
rachel: getting an alert from bucket-policy-monitor: 4 backup snapshots created without kmsKeyName on snapshots/prod/2026-05-14. Not sure why.
enc-ops-bot: alert: storage.objects.create without kmsKeyName detected for prefix= snapshots/prod/2026-05-14/ count=4 first_seen=2102223200
sam: any recent alias/key rotations? we rotated snap-key.alias -> snap-key-v2 earlier today to roll from compromised test key.
neil: i rotated the alias at 01:10 UTC and updated defaultBucketKms for the bucket at 01:12. should have been seamless.
rachel: suspect timeline matches: objects created ~01:09-01:11 which is during the alias swap. maybe clients hit old key name and KMS rejected and client retried without kms param.
nana_p: checking upload-agent logs; found entries: "EncryptRequest: KMS alias unresolved -> PERMISSION_DENIED -> proceed_unencrypted=true" in a couple of old agent versions.
oncall-sre: immediate mitigation: block the older agent via fleet policy, and add a deny binding to prevent uploads without kmsKeyName to snapshots/* prefix.
compliance: inventory any tenant snapshots in that set. if tenant-owned, may need to notify. Hold off until we have scope.
neil: cloud audit logs show a short window where the alias mapping returned 404 due to propagation; some SA calls fell back. also saw ephemeral grants for backup-uploader expire at 01:08 due to TTL config; that didn't help.
sam: TTL on ephemeral grants is intended, but we should not allow client fallback to unencrypted. adding org policy to deny creation without kmsKeyName is high priority.
rachel: started copying affected objects to quarantine with metadata preserved and recording generations. also saving audit log exports to BigQuery for correlation.
enc-ops-bot: recommended runbook: 1) freeze affected SA, 2) quarantine objects, 3) check KMS key versions/aliases, 4) determine rewrap vs reingest, 5) prepare customer notification if tenant data impacted.
neil: will add alias rotation guidance to runbook: ensure no TTLed grant windows overlap rotation and coordinate default-key update after alias switch completes.
nana_p: hotfix pushed: fleet policy blocking agents <2.5.0 and agent patch to fail uploads if encrypt fails instead of falling back.
sam: i'll open postmortem and a PR for org policy deny-create-without-kms. assigning remediation owner: neil.
rachel: thanks team. following up with compliance once tenant list is finalized.
